metadata.question: Did the water extent of Lake Sambhar, India, decrease between 2018 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8 for water body mapping - Date: 2018 (full year or specific season) vs 2019 (same period) - Location: Lake Sambhar, India (coordinates ~26.9°N, 75.0°E) - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or simple water classification to measure water extent 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using QA bands - Focus on water pixels (NDWI > threshold, typically > 0.3) - Calculate area of water extent for both years 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - If no images found for either year → C1 - If after cloud masking, no valid pixels remain → C2 - If NDWI values are invalid (NaN, out of range) → C3 - If water extent decreased (2019 < 2018) → A - If water extent increased or stayed same (2019 >= 2018) → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Lake Sambhar geometry const lakeSambhar = ee.Geometry.Point([75.0, 26.9]).buffer(15000); // Define time periods const startDate2018 = '2018-01-01'; const endDate2018 = '2018-12-31'; const startDate2019 = '2019-01-01'; const endDate2019 = '2019-12-31'; // Load Sentinel-2 collections const s2_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(startDate2018, endDate2018) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const s2_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(startDate2019, endDate2019) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); // Check if collections have data const count2018 = s2_2018.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = s2_2019.size().getInfo(); if (count2018 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log(`2018 Images: ${count2018}, 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`2018 Images: ${count2018}, 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); // Function to calculate water extent function getWaterExtent(collection, year) { return collection .map(function(img) { const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); const water = ndwi.gt(0.3); return water; }) .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .rename('water_pixels'); } // Get water extent for both years const waterExtent2018 = getWaterExtent(s2_2018, 2018); const waterExtent2019 = getWaterExtent(s2_2019, 2019); // Calculate pixel counts const stats2018 = waterExtent2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2019 = waterExtent2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixels2018 = stats2018.water_pixels; const pixels2019 = stats2019.water_pixels; // Validate results if (pixels2018 === null || pixels2019 === null || pixels2018 === 0 || pixels2019 === 0) { console.log(`2018 Water Pixels: ${pixels2018}, 2019 Water Pixels: ${pixels2019}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate extents const extent2018 = pixels2018 * 20 * 20 / 1e6; // Convert to km² const extent2019 = pixels2019 * 20 * 20 / 1e6; console.log(`2018 Water Extent: ${extent2018.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2019 Water Extent: ${extent2019.toFixed(2)} km²`); // Determine if water extent decreased if (extent2019 < extent2018) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
